systemBridge.en: Every credential directly informs the PRJ-01..05 systems: Course 05 (99.37% Marketing Analytics) underpins POAS, attribution windows, and RM 0.00 settlement waterfalls (PRJ-02/04/05); Course 06 (97.50% E-commerce) drives SKU economics and TikTok/Shopee margin defense (PRJ-03/05); Course 04 (97.00% Email) informs automated B2B drafts and lifecycle win-backs (PRJ-01/03); and the UMP Blockchain Diploma (2022) shapes deterministic, tamper-evident audit ledgers and SHA-256 hashing (PRJ-03/04).
systemBridge.bm: Setiap tauliah diterjemahkan terus ke dalam sistem PRJ-01..05: Kursus 05 (99.37% Analitik & Pengukuran Pemasaran) mendasari kiraan POAS, tetingkap atribusi dan aliran tunai penyelesaian RM 0.00 (PRJ-02/04/05); Kursus 06 (97.50% E-Dagang) memacu ekonomi unit SKU serta kawalan margin TikTok/Shopee (PRJ-03/05); Kursus 04 (97.00% Pemasaran E-mel) membentuk draf B2B automatik serta pemulihan pelanggan (PRJ-01/03); manakala Diploma Blockchain UMP (2022) membentuk reka bentuk lejar audit kalis manipulasi dan penyulitan sehala SHA-256 (PRJ-03/04).
